title: Heavy-Laden
summary: HEAVY-LA'DEN, adjective Laden with a heavy burden. HEAVY SPAR, noun [See Baryte.] A genus of minerals of four species, viz. rhomboidal, prismatic, di-prismatic and axifrangible.
